title: Technology consideration: Quantum computers and post-quantum cryptography (FR)
summary: Technology consideration by the Swiss National Cyber Security Centre on quantum computers and post-quantum cryptography, stressing that migration to PQC is a long process requiring planning in line with current standardisation.

title: Technology consideration: Quantum computers and post-quantum cryptography (DE)
summary: German-language technology consideration by the Swiss National Cyber Security Centre explaining post-quantum cryptography (PQK), what has been achieved and where matters stand.

title: BACS assessment: Post-quantum cryptography and measures to be taken (FR)
summary: Assessment by the Swiss Federal Office for Cybersecurity (BACS) on post-quantum cryptography, following its technology consideration, setting out the situation and the measures to be taken.

title: BACS assessment: Post-quantum cryptography (DE)
summary: German-language assessment by the Swiss Federal Office for Cybersecurity (BACS) on quantum-computer-resistant methods and algorithms developed as post-quantum cryptography (PQK).

title: Annual Report 2025 - National Cyber Security Centre NCSC
summary: Annual report of the Swiss National Cyber Security Centre, listing technology considerations including quantum computers and post-quantum cryptography among its published work.

title: Report on the implementation of the National Cyber Strategy (NCS) 2024
summary: Report on the implementation of Switzerland's National Cyber Strategy, citing quantum computing and post-quantum cryptography among the technology considerations produced.

title: Annual Report 2024 - Federal Office for Cybersecurity BACS (DE)
summary: Annual report of the Swiss Federal Office for Cybersecurity (BACS), referencing its assessment of the need for action in relation to post-quantum cryptography (PQK).

title: Post-Quantum Cryptography (BIT/FOITT)
summary: Document from the Swiss Federal Office of Information Technology, Systems and Telecommunication (BIT) emphasising the need to switch early to post-quantum cryptography, especially for long-term confidential data.

title: Action Plan to a Quantum-Safe Financial Future
summary: Action plan hosted by the Swiss State Secretariat for International Financial Matters (SIF) proposing a coordinated transition to post-quantum cryptography for the financial sector.

title: Confederation's transition to post-quantum cryptography (Curia Vista affair 24.4398)
summary: Swiss parliamentary affair on the use of quantum-safe / post-quantum cryptography by the Confederation, noting the federal focus on post-quantum cryptography over quantum key distribution.

title: Quantum-safe systems in the Confederation (Curia Vista affair 23.3689)
summary: Swiss parliamentary affair on quantum-safe systems in the Confederation, referencing the federal selection process for post-quantum cryptography expected to conclude in 2024.

title: Positioning Switzerland as a leader in quantum computing and post-quantum cryptography (Curia Vista affair 24.4511)
summary: Swiss parliamentary affair seeking proposals on how Switzerland can take a leading role in international bodies on quantum computing and post-quantum cryptography.

title: Report of the Security Policy Committee of the Council of States (22.4270)
summary: Committee report of the Council of States Security Policy Committee listing cryptography including post-quantum cryptography, quantum computers and AI among priority technologies.

title: Swiss National Bank, 118th Annual Report 2025
summary: Annual report of the Swiss National Bank noting the adaptation of existing infrastructure to the requirements of post-quantum cryptography.

title: Swiss National Bank, 116th Annual Report 2023
summary: Annual report of the Swiss National Bank noting that a post-quantum cryptography mode was used to protect central bank digital currency (CBDC) against attacks by quantum computers.

title: Post Quantum Cryptography - migration of the federal administration's PKI (EN)
summary: New BIT/FOITT web resource on the federal administration's migration to post-quantum cryptography, explaining that RSA-based PKI processes will become vulnerable to quantum computers and setting out certificate key-length and algorithm changes across certificate Classes A, B, C and E, with Q&A event recordings dated February and April 2026.

title: Post Quantum Cryptography - Migration der PKI des Bundes (DE)
summary: German-language BIT/FOITT web resource on the federal administration's migration to post-quantum cryptography, covering the threat quantum computers pose to RSA-based procedures and the planned changes to certificate algorithms and key lengths, with documentation updated in 2026.

title: Increased research work on the electronic identity of the Swiss Confederation (quantum-secure e-ID)
summary: Announcement (6 March 2026) by armasuisse, in cooperation with the Federal Office of Justice and HEIG-VD, of a research programme that from 2026 will analyse the e-ID technology stack and develop a demonstrator for a quantum-secure e-ID architecture, with research funds for post-quantum cryptography allocated through to 2029.

title: Technology brief: Quantum computers and post-quantum cryptography (EN, 08.12.2025)
summary: English-language NCSC (BACS) technology brief on quantum computers and post-quantum cryptography dated 8 December 2025, explaining the threat to current cryptographic methods, the state of PQC progress and where further action is needed; this is the current edition and a distinct URL from the French and German versions already in the corpus.

title: Cyber-Defence Campus Semi-Annual Report 2025/1: Quantum Technologies - Trends and Implications for Cyberdefence
summary: First-half 2025 semi-annual research report by the federal Cyber-Defence Campus (armasuisse Science and Technology, DDPS) surveying quantum-technology trends for cyber defence, including post-quantum cryptography and quantum-safe migration; flagged for review as agency research output rather than a policy or standards document.

title: FINMA Guidance 05/2026: Quantum computing
summary: Supervisory guidance of 9 July 2026 in which the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority reports a survey of 60 authorised banks, insurers, asset managers and financial market infrastructures showing that 72% have taken no measures on quantum-safe cryptography and only 8% have a PQC roadmap. FINMA states that existing principles-based operational-risk and governance requirements already cover quantum risk, and recommends a board-approved PQC strategy, a cryptographic inventory, crypto-agility, PQC-ready outsourcing arrangements and a PQC roadmap drawn up by mid-2027 at the latest.

title: FINMA guidance on quantum computing (press release, 9 July 2026)
summary: FINMA press release announcing Guidance 05/2026, reporting that supervised institutions largely lack a clear roadmap and forward-looking planning for migration to quantum-safe encryption. It sets out FINMA's expectation that institutions address the risk from cryptographically relevant quantum computers in their governance and risk management and move towards crypto-agility.

title: Empfohlene Algorithmen - Abkündigung RSA (Terminierung RSA)
summary: Federal Office of Information Technology, Systems and Telecommunication document (dated 24 February 2026 on the BIT PQC page) setting out recommended algorithms and a dated RSA sunset plan, citing NIST and ETSI advice to begin post-quantum cryptography migration immediately and 'harvest now, decrypt later' risk. It phases the transition as 2024-2026 inventory and PQC pilots, 2026-2029 migration of critical systems with hybrid algorithms and PKI updates, 2030-2034 full changeover with no new RSA applications, and complete deactivation of RSA from 2035, naming CRYSTALS-Kyber, CRYSTALS-Dilithium, FALCON and SPHINCS+ as recommended PQC algorithms.

title: Präsentation: Anpassungen Schlüssellängen für Zertifikate - Informationen aus der Swiss Government PKI
summary: Swiss Government PKI briefing presentation (slide date 24 February 2026, listed 9 March 2026) explaining that quantum computers threaten all RSA-based procedures, that 'harvest now, decrypt later' attacks are already occurring, and that retrofitting PQC into existing PKI is operationally complex. It sets out the Swiss Government PKI roadmap: shortened TLS certificate lifetimes from March 2026, increased key lengths for Classes A, B, C and E by 2027, a new PKI engine from 2027, support for hybrid cryptography and hybrid test certificates already available.

title: Jahresreporting der Forschungsprogramme Cyberspace und Cyber & Intelligence Analytics
summary: armasuisse news item, dated 30 March 2026, on the annual reporting of its Cyberspace and Cyber & Intelligence Analytics research programmes. It notes that a Cyber-Defence Campus PhD fellow presented new post-quantum cryptography approaches based on knot theory.
